# 5 bed detached house for sale

> Sherry FitzGerald Crowley are delighted to bring to the market this impressive five bedroom detached property, set on an elevated south facing site offering panoramic views across Clew Bay and some of its islands to Croagh Patrick. The spacious and well proportioned house was built circa 2000. Some of its quality finishes include timber floors and a beech kitchen.

## Fakta
- Typ: detached house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 5 bed
- Plocha: 225 m²
- Energetická náročnost: C3
- Lokalita: Sandhill, Tiernaur, Newport
- Cena: 495 000 €
